about_the_game:
When reality collapses, only live streaming can rewrite fate!

You—Sophie Sullivan, a Mary Sue author on the brink of despair—are forced to sign a "soul contract" with the flamboyant King of the Underworld, Damian Kingsley, to save your critically ill brother and grandmother.

Crossing between the realms of life and death, you begin a thrilling and shame-filled live broadcast of survival!

Tame the protagonists you created, face vengeful spirits, navigate the prideful politics of the Underworld’s elite...

Every choice could elevate you to the top of the "villain food chain" or reduce you to a forgotten "cannon-fodder mom" erased by the system.

Now, open your live stream—

Popularity is your currency, choices are your destiny, and this time, you are the writer!

Game Features：

1. Dual-Life Dilemma【Netherworld Streamer】
Cyberbullied by day, ghost-hunting streamer by night! Will you rise to fame as the top influencer of the underworld, or crash and burn under the system’s rules? Your choices decide your fate!

2. Dangerous Desires【High-Stakes Romance】
Tsundere Underworld King, Yandere Zombie CEO, and a twisted ex-BFF—everyone’s a maniac! Fail to win their hearts and you'll face instant BE (Bad End)!

3. Style Unlimited【Dress-Up】
Dozens of stunning outfits to collect—dark seductress, elegant fairy, or gothic enchantress. Show your style, charm the dead (and maybe the living)!

Game Rules：

1. Stream Showdowns【Live PK Battles】
Every decision affects your stream’s popularity. Audience donations might save your life—or lead you to ruin. Will you become the queen of chaos, or end up a viral joke?

2. Wicked Parenting【Raising the Little Hades】
Start the game with a mysterious "egg" and nurture it through multiple stages of growth—eventually unlocking a unique story with your very own baby King of the Underworld!

3. Interactive Chaos【Unleash the Wild Moves】
Soak in hot springs to boost your beauty, use charms to eavesdrop or defeat ghosts. Master every shady trick in the book to survive in this deadly world of the dead!

4. Playful Strategies【Farming】
Grow magical plants and gift them to raise affection. Tend your deadly garden by day, battle saints in livestreams by night. Welcome to your chaotic life in the underworld!

short_description: A modern fantasy game blending romance, interactive nurturing, and live streaming. Play as a fallen author, bound to the Underworld live system after online bullying. Grow plants, gift them to raise affection, bathe with the male lead, and battle with the Virgin Mary. Your chance to rise again!
